question: Development of ________ was the motto of the first five year plan in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**agriculture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The development of Agriculture was the motto of the first Five Year Plan in India.**
 
• **Agriculture Focus:**
 
 
• **​**The first Five Year Plan** (1951-1956) was developed with a focus on improving India's agricultural sector.**
 
• It aimed to increase food production and reduce dependency on agricultural imports.
 
 
 
• **Investment:**
 
 
• **​**The plan put a significant portion of the total investment towards agriculture and irrigation projects.
 
 
 
• **Community Development Program:**
 
 
• **​**The first Five Year Plan introduced the community development program in 1952, which aimed to bring about social and economic transformation in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Land Reforms:**
 
 
• The plan encouraged various land reforms, including the abolition of intermediaries (like Zamindars), tenancy legislation, and the organization of cooperative farming.
 
 
 
• **Improving Infrastructure:**
 
 
• **​**The plan also allocated funds to improve agricultural infrastructure and other related industries to help provide the necessary tools and resources for agricultural growth.
